affected_subject.reason: Identifies AtomWallet._validateSignature and its InvalidSignatureS branch.

trigger_or_action.reason: High-s signature (s' = curve_order - s) derived from a valid owner signature triggers the branch.

direct_effect.reason: Branch reverts instead of returning SIG_VALIDATION_FAILED, propagating through handleOps and failing the bundle.

safety_relation_basis.reason: ERC-4337 spec requires SHOULD return SIG_VALIDATION_FAILED without reverting; actual behavior reverts, giving expected-vs-actual relation.

summary: All four dimensions are supported: affected function, high-s trigger, revert effect, and ERC-4337 spec-based expected-vs-actual relation.
